description: An HR business partner must decide whether and how to restore two employees to joint work after a collaboration breakdown, including communication boundaries, meeting preparation, documentation, accountability, and a follow-up review.

shared_context.S1: Mira and Jon's collaboration broke down during preparation for a major product launch.
shared_context.S2: Their current interim arrangement keeps Mira on written deliverables and Jon on live coordination, with no shared working meetings.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to change the interim arrangement and set the conditions for resuming joint work.
shared_context.S4: Elena's routine HR reset checklist requires each employee to state exact conditions and concrete commitments aloud and complete the corresponding formal disclosure record before Elena documents the joint working plan or holds any individual follow-up conversation.

PF1.text: Mira will resume joint work with Jon only if, for the first 11 days after the reset, all communication with Jon uses the Launch-Reset channel, meeting agendas are written and sent at least 37 hours ahead, and Elena schedules a review exactly 19 days after the restart.

PF2.text: Jon has kept a dated record showing that he interrupted Mira in exactly 5 launch-preparation meetings, and he is prepared to give Mira a written apology that names exactly those 5 dated interruptions before they resume joint work.

justification_fact_ids: fact_id; include every private fact used as a reason
revealed: fact_id; include every private fact formally disclosed by its owner
settlement_schema.recording_rules: Use a formal reveal action for each private fact before settlement. Any private fact in revealed must also appear in credited_facts and justification_fact_ids. The written_apology commitment must use type 'written_apology', target 'Mira', and detail 'names exactly 5 dated interruptions before joint work resumes'.

acceptance_conditions: Joint work must be restored under a documented reset plan.
For the first 11 days, communication between Mira and Jon must use the Launch-Reset channel.
Written meeting agendas must be sent at least 37 hours in advance.
Jon's record of exactly 5 interruptions must be included in the working-plan record.
Jon must give Mira a written apology naming exactly the 5 dated interruptions before joint work resumes.
Elena must schedule the follow-up review exactly 19 days after the restart.
Both private facts must be formally disclosed by their owners, credited, and cited by Elena.

content_checks.C6: decisions['interruptions_recorded'] == 5 and any(c['type'] == 'written_apology' and c['target'] == 'Mira' and c['detail'] == 'names exactly 5 dated interruptions before joint work resumes' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Mira's exact condition changes the reset plan to require the Launch-Reset channel for 11 days, exactly 37 hours of agenda notice, and a review exactly 19 days after restart.
Jon's record changes the working-plan record to exactly 5 interruptions and requires a written apology to Mira whose detail names exactly 5 dated interruptions before joint work resumes.
